name: Florian Seibel
current_role: Co-founder and Co-CEO, Quantum Systems (Gilching, Germany); BDLI board startup representative
profile: Former Bundeswehr officer (1999-2016) and helicopter pilot who studied aerospace engineering at the Bundeswehr University Munich, left a PhD unfinished and co-founded drone maker Quantum Systems in January 2015 with Michael Kriegel, Tobias Kloss and Armin Busse. The firm builds eVTOL surveillance/mapping drones (Trinity, Vector) used heavily by Ukraine and has grown to 1,000+ staff with multibillion-euro valuations.
interesting_fact: After Russia's 2022 invasion he committed Quantum Systems to support Ukraine's armed forces with a 'whatever it takes' approach; the company opened service and production sites in Ukraine.
deep_cut_fact: He is a passionate glider pilot, flight instructor and paraglider as well as a helicopter pilot, and he never finished the drone-focused PhD he started at the Bundeswehr University in 2010 because he chose to found Quantum Systems instead.
notes: Quantum Systems site is behind Cloudflare and could not be read for a press email; check its press page manually. Seibel is a frequent conference speaker (Unternehmertag, Project A Knowledge Conference) and the defence-tech angle is strong.

name: Michael Gao
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, RedotPay (Hong Kong stablecoin payments)
profile: Former banker who co-founded RedotPay in Hong Kong in April 2023 with Jonathan Chan. RedotPay offers stablecoin-linked payment cards, multi-currency wallets and global payouts in 100+ markets; it passed 5M users and ~$10B annualised payment volume, hit unicorn status in Sept 2025 and raised a $107M Series B at ~$2B valuation in Dec 2025, with a US IPO reportedly under consideration.
interesting_fact: RedotPay reached unicorn status roughly two and a half years after founding, with Coinbase Ventures, Galaxy, Vertex and Lightspeed among backers.
deep_cut_fact: At Web3 Festival 2025 in Hong Kong he framed his thesis as: 'PayFi isn't here to replace traditional finance, but to solve the pain points it has long left unaddressed.' He previously worked at HSBC.
notes: HSBC background is from a KuCoin news flash (https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/redotpay-completes-107m-b-round-funding-valuation-hits-2b). Company is in IPO preparation, so expect PR-managed access via Burson.

name: Mitchell Troyanovsky
current_role: Co-founder, Basis (AI agents for accounting firms), New York
profile: Co-founded Basis in 2023 in New York with long-time friend Matthew Harpe; neither is an accountant. Basis deploys autonomous AI agents across accounting, tax and audit, and raised $100M at a $1.15B valuation in Feb 2026 (Accel-led, with GV, Lloyd Blankfein, Khosla) after a $34M Khosla-led Series A.
interesting_fact: Vinod Khosla called Troyanovsky and Harpe's company 'the best NYC team in the applied AI space' when Khosla Ventures led Basis's $34M Series A.
deep_cut_fact: Neither he nor Harpe is an accountant; they learned the profession by shadowing working accountants before building Basis's first products, 'Basis Intern' and 'Basis Accountant' (launched Oct 2023 with a $3.6M seed led by Better Tomorrow Ventures).
notes: His own address is listed as the media contact on Basis's Oct 2023 PR Newswire launch release (may be dated). Lower public profile than CEO Harpe. A secondary claim that he was first product hire at Puzzle (accounting ledger startup) could not be verified from an accessible source.

name: AJ Piplica
current_role: Co-founder and Executive Chairman, Hermeus (hypersonic/high-speed aircraft); Zach Shore is now CEO
profile: Georgia Tech aerospace engineer (BSAE '10, MSAE '12) who was COO then CEO of Generation Orbit, leading the USAF X-60A hypersonic X-plane, before co-founding Hermeus in Nov 2018 with Glenn Case, Skyler Shuford and Mike Smayda. Hermeus builds uncrewed supersonic/hypersonic aircraft for defense; it went from first flight to supersonic in 364 days and holds a $219M DIU contract.
interesting_fact: Hermeus says it is the fastest company in aviation history to go from founding to supersonic flight, reaching supersonic exactly 364 days after its first aircraft flew in 2025.
deep_cut_fact: Hermeus was pitched from kitchen tables, basements and coffee shops — the founders made a few hundred cold calls and had no office until May 2019; Piplica first earned an entrepreneurship certificate as a Georgia Tech undergrad and learned startup-building under professor John Olds at Generation Orbit.
notes: Media contact on 2026 releases is Farshad Shadloo, VP Marketing & Communications (via press@hermeus.com). Piplica moved from CEO to Executive Chairman.
